title: Lisa McClain Stock Trades: Seagate Sale and Four Purchases (Oct 2026)
content:
Rep. Lisa McClain (MI-9) disclosed five stock trades on October 12, 2026, dated September 28–30: a $15,001–$50,000 sale of Seagate Technology (STX) and four purchases of $1,001–$15,000 each, in Microsoft, ImmunityBio (twice) and Caterpillar.

Trade data: Bargo, compiled from U.S. House and Senate STOCK Act filings.

Transaction dates: Sep 28 and Sep 30, 2026. Disclosure date: Oct 12, 2026 (12 to 14 days later). Member: Rep. Lisa McClain, MI-9 (House).

What's been disclosed

  • One sale: Seagate Technology (STX), $15,001–$50,000, on September 30.
  • Four purchases: Microsoft (MSFT) on September 30, ImmunityBio (IBRX) on September 28 and 30, and Caterpillar (CAT) on September 28, each $1,001–$15,000.
  • Price since: Bargo's estimate puts Seagate about 30.1% lower on October 30 than on the sale date, Caterpillar about 24.1% lower, ImmunityBio between 2.7% and 12.2% lower, and Microsoft about 1.8% higher.

Quick FAQ

How long after the trades were they disclosed?
12 to 14 days after the trades, which were dated September 28 and 30. The STOCK Act gives members 45 days from the transaction to disclose it.

Why are the amounts ranges?
Filings report value bands such as $15,001–$50,000 instead of exact dollar amounts.

Where does the price comparison come from?
It is Bargo's estimate, comparing the price on the transaction date with the October 30 price. It is not the member's actual execution price.
